title: 第二十一章 马无夜草不肥人无横财不富第二十二章 出城杀妖颜暮灵尾行
slug: 看守废丹房三年我偷偷成仙了
lines: 买了……几件灵器？
吕文秋嘴角抽搐了一下。
你一个小散修，这么吹牛逼你家里人知道吗？
买灵器，还买几件？
你以为买大白菜呢？
吕文秋哑然一笑，旋即摇了摇头道：“王道友说笑了。”
“谁和你说笑了？”
秦凡淡淡的道：“你觉得我是买不起？还是这雾山坊市没有卖的？”
吕文秋不由微微动容，“王道友此话，莫非当真买了灵器？”
“你猜呢？”
吕文秋面色顿时冷了下来，“王道友如此戏耍在下，看来王道友似乎是知晓贫道今日此来的目的了。”
“光天化日之下，带着两个藏头露尾的帮手拦路，要不是想杀人夺宝，我真的想不出来你要做什么。”
“你说是吗，吕道友？”
秦凡似笑非笑的望着吕文秋。
吕文秋冷笑一声，“王道友好警惕的心思，不曾想，这都能被你给察觉到。”
就在此时，一左一右两棵大树后边，两道身影缓步走了出来，一老一少。
“老朽张不平，见过王道友。”
老者一身褐色衣衫，轻抚山羊胡，对秦凡笑呵呵的道。
“在下陈旭源，亦是久闻王道友大名，对王道友杀妖救人的义举，可谓颇为敬佩。”
年轻修士一身淡青衣衫，眼角狭长，嘴角噙笑，对秦凡拱手说道。
这一老一少，老的是炼气十二层，年轻的，是炼气十一层，身上没一件法器，穿的都是寻常绸缎，可见和吕文秋一般，都是散修出身。
啧，有点失望啊。
不过算了，苍蝇腿也是肉，挑三拣四的可不是啥好习惯。
“既然都露面了，那咱们之间也别废话了，一起上吧。”
“道爷赶时间办正事儿，没时间陪你们在这里浪费。”
帮手出现，秦凡依旧面不改色，双手背后，神情淡然的对吕文秋道。
吕文秋三人皆是一怔。
啥意思。
这是，没瞧得起他们？
“有意思……”
吕文秋笑了，“既然王道友如此自信，那我等三人也就不客气了。”
“毕竟杀人夺宝这种事，最怕的就是夜长梦多。”
“专业。”
content_en:
Did you buy...how many spiritual weapons?
The corner of Lu Wenqiu's mouth twitched.
You are a small casual cultivator. Do your family members know that you are so bragging?
If you want to buy a spiritual weapon, how many more should you buy?
What do you think about buying Chinese cabbage?
Lu Wenqiu smiled hoarsely, then shook his head and said, "Fellow Daoist Wang is joking."
"Who is kidding you?"
Qin Fan said calmly: "Do you think I can't afford it? Or is it not sold in Wushanfang Market?"
Lu Wenqiu couldn't help but feel slightly moved, "Did Fellow Wang say that he really bought a spiritual weapon?"
"What do you think?"
"..."
Lu Wenqiu's face suddenly turned cold, "Fellow Daoist Wang is teasing me like this. It seems that Friend Daoist Wang knows the purpose of Pindao's visit today."
"In broad daylight, you blocked the road with two hidden helpers. If you didn't want to kill people and seize treasures, I really can't think of what you were going to do."
"Do you think so, Fellow Daoist Lu?"
Qin Fan looked at Lu Wenqiu with a half-smile.
"Heh."
Lu Wenqiu sneered, "Wang Dao's friendly and vigilant thoughts, I never thought that you would be able to detect this."
At this moment, two figures slowly walked out from behind two big trees, one on the left and one on the right, one old and one young.
"Old Zhang Buping has met fellow Taoist Wang."
The old man was dressed in brown clothes, gently stroking his goatee, and smiled at Qin Fan.
"Your Excellency, Chen Xuyuan, has also heard of Fellow Daoist Wang for a long time, and I have great admiration for Fellow Daoist Wang's righteous deeds of killing demons and saving people."
The young monk was dressed in light green clothes, with narrow eyes and a smile on his lips, and he said to Qin Fan.
There was an old man and a young man. The old one was at the twelfth level of Qi Refining, and the young one was at the eleventh level of Qi Refining. They didn't have any magic weapon on their bodies, and they were all wearing ordinary silk and satin. It can be seen that like Lu Wenqiu, they were both casual cultivators.
Tsk, a little disappointed.
But forget it, fly legs are also meat, and it’s not a good habit to be picky.
"Now that we've all shown up, let's stop talking nonsense and let's go together."
"Master Tao is in a hurry to do business, and I don't have time to waste here with you."
When the helper appeared, Qin Fan remained calm and spoke to Lu Wenqiu calmly behind his hands.
Lu Wenqiu and the three others were startled.
What does it mean?
Are you not looking down upon them?
"Interesting..."
Lu Wenqiu smiled, "Since Fellow Daoist Wang is so confident, then the three of us will not be polite."
"After all, when it comes to killing people and seizing treasures, the most terrifying thing is long nights and lots of dreams."
"Professional."
